services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Bring your birthday plans to our Lorton school. A Taekwondo party starts with the guest of honor, a date, and a group of friends. Tell the team your child’s age and expected guest count to find out which party arrangements are available. Check availability with the school and confirm how the booking is secured. Include arrival, activity time, and collection when planning the invitation. Guest ages and numbers affect the party arrangements. Let the school know who is coming, including children who have not tried martial arts before. Review the activities, supplies, and any food arrangements together. services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Dynamic Kick’s A+ After School program in Lansdowne brings school pickup, homework time, and Taekwondo into the afternoon. Start by checking whether your child’s school is on the current pickup route and which days have space. Pickup coverage is the first thing to check. Give the team your child’s school name, grade, and the days you need before making enrollment arrangements. Homework time is part of the afternoon. Talk through what your child usually brings home and how that time works at the school; completed homework is not something to assume. Taekwondo adds physical practice to the hours after school.
